tools.name: exclusion_normalize
tools.description: Normalize identifiers before source screening. This operation does not determine eligibility. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/exclusion/normalize. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: exclusion_screen
tools.description: Compare a vendor name with the official OFAC SDN list. Candidate matches require human review; source unavailability produces WARN. Price $0.15 USDC. POST /api/v1/exclusion/screen. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: exclusion_evidence-report
tools.description: Screen a vendor name against the official OFAC SDN list and produce a PDF with source status, candidate records, timestamp, and snapshot hash. Matches are not identity confirmations. Price $0.15 USDC. POST /api/v1/exclusion/evidence-report. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not

tools.name: exclusion_uk-screen
tools.description: Compare a vendor name with the official UK Sanctions List XML. Candidate matches require human review; source unavailability produces WARN. Price $0.15 USDC. POST /api/v1/exclusion/uk/screen. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: exclusion_uk-changes
tools.description: Retrieve changes to the UK Sanctions List since a given date, using the official Last Updated field and designation dates. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/exclusion/uk/changes. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: exclusion_batch-screen
tools.description: Screen multiple vendors against the official OFAC SDN list. Each vendor is screened independently. Price $0.10 USDC. POST /api/v1/exclusion/batch-screen. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: exclusion_multi-list-screen
tools.description: Combine OFAC SDN and UK Sanctions List screening for a single vendor. Matches across lists require human identity review. Price $0.20 USDC. POST /api/v1/exclusion/multi-list/screen. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "exclusion" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: exclusion_screen, exclusion_evidence-report, exclusion_uk-screen, exclusion_uk-changes, exclusion_batch-screen, exclusion_multi-list-screen · Private data: exclusion_evidence-report · Public sink: exclusion_normalize, exclusion_screen, exclusion_evidence-report, exclusion_uk-screen, exclusion_uk-changes, exclusion_batch-screen, exclusion_multi-list-screen · Destructive: exclusion_normalize, exclusion_screen, exclusion_evidence-report, exclusion_uk-screen, exclusion_uk-changes, exclusion_batch-screen, exclusion_multi-list-screen.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: exclusion_screen, exclusion_evidence-report, exclusion_uk-screen, exclusion_uk-changes, exclusion_batch-screen, exclusion_multi-list-screen · Private data: exclusion_evidence-report · Public sink: exclusion_normalize, exclusion_screen, exclusion_evidence-report, exclusion_uk-screen, exclusion_uk-changes, exclusion_batch-screen, exclusion_multi-list-screen · Destructive: exclusion_normalize, exclusion_screen, exclusion_evidence-report, exclusion_uk-screen, exclusion_uk-changes, exclusion_batch-screen, exclusion_multi-list-screen

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
